name: ntfy
description: Push notifications to phones and desktops over plain HTTP PUT/POST. Also a target for nook's own update alerts.

env.desc: read-write, read-only, write-only or deny-all for anyone without a login

files.run:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
mkdir -p "$HOME/data/ntfy/attachments"
export NTFY_LISTEN_HTTP="127.0.0.1:$PORT"
export NTFY_BEHIND_PROXY=true
export NTFY_CACHE_FILE="$HOME/data/ntfy/cache.db"
export NTFY_AUTH_FILE="$HOME/data/ntfy/auth.db"
export NTFY_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/data/ntfy/attachments"
exec ./ntfy serve
